testcase.name: Scenario: The panel title does not close a pinned expansion: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:274:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: The panel title does not close a pinned expansion ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and pinned ✔ When the user clicks the Modify title at the bottom of the additional area ✔ Then the additional command area remains open ✔ When the user unpins the additional area ✔ And the user clicks its Modify title again ✔ Then the additional command area closes
